turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How are things going today at the clinic? Have you and Tom made any more progress with the planning for your summer 2028 wedding?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Happy Friday indeed. Wedding planning has been on the back burner this week, honestly. Tom and I are just taking a little breather from all the decisions. I started my morning with a warm, earthy drink made of whisked green tea powder and steamed oat milk, which was super comforting, and then just headed straight to work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That green tea drink sounds like the perfect way to ease into a busy Friday! And taking a breather from wedding planning is definitely smart—2028 is still a ways off, so there's no need to rush and burn yourselves out.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Exactly, we have plenty of time. It's been a busy morning at the outpatient clinic, but I just sat down for my break. I brought a homemade bowl packed with brown rice, black beans, fajita veggies, salsa, and grilled chicken that I prepped last night. Much better than takeout!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That homemade burrito bowl sounds delicious and so satisfying for a workday lunch! It's always nice when meal prep actually works out like that. Did you get a chance to use your roommate's new espresso machine this morning, or was it strictly the green tea latte?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually stuck completely to my green tea drink today! I wanted something a bit more mellow than espresso, though that machine has been getting a lot of use lately.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Makes sense, sometimes you just want that calmer energy. How is the Tucson summer heat treating you today? I imagine it's pretty intense by late July.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, it's scorching today, definitely over a hundred degrees already! I'm so glad to be working indoors in the air conditioning. I'll probably just stay inside tonight and practice some of my online Italian lessons.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move to stay in! How are the Italian lessons going? Are you finding it easy to keep up with the online format?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's going really well! It's self-paced, which is perfect for my nurse schedule. I've been learning how to introduce myself and order food, which is super fun.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's fantastic! You'll be fully prepared to order some amazing dishes when you eventually visit. Have you been able to fit in any sourdough baking lately, or has it been too hot to turn on the oven?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I've paused the baking for now because of the heat. No one wants to turn a hot oven on when it's this warm in Tucson! I'll wait until it cools down a bit in the fall.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Very wise. A hot oven is the last thing you need right now! I hope you have a relaxing evening with your Italian lessons and a cool breeze from the AC.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! That's exactly the plan. Have a great weekend!
